text: Over the past 30 days, visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have highlighted concerns primarily about the food offerings. Two reviewers mentioned the limited menu range, with one describing some dishes as bland and others as an unusual mix of flavors. There were also complaints about the value, with one visitor calling the food overpriced and minimal. Additionally, service issues were noted, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Overall, the average rating was low, indicating these areas need attention.

windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported limited menu options, bland or poorly prepared dishes, and dissatisfaction with pricing. Service delays and long wait times were also mentioned, including times when ordering was unavailable due to kitchen backups. While some healthy food choices were noted, overall the food quality and variety need improvement. Attention to service efficiency and clearer communication about menu availability would help address visitor concerns.
